field.label: DNS service errors
field.help: Notify when Unbound or Dnsmasq logs a startup error, a binding problem or an upstream DNS failure.

field.label: DHCP service errors
field.help: Notify when the DHCP server reports an address-allocation failure, an address conflict or an exhausted pool.

field.label: New DHCP devices
field.help: Notify when a device receives a lease for the first time within the retained event history. Lease logging is required; routine renewals are ignored.

field.label: Firmware and package updates
field.help: Notify when the system logs a firmware or package update result, including failures.

field.label: Backup errors
field.help: Notify when a supported configuration-backup task records a failure.

field.label: Backend and service errors
field.help: Notify when an OPNsense backend task fails. The affected executable and error code are included when available; sensitive command arguments are omitted.

field.label: Local backup freshness alerts
field.help: Check the newest configuration snapshot in a chosen local folder. This does not prove successful upload to Git, Google Drive or other remote services.

field.label: Maximum backup age
field.help: Alert when the newest local backup snapshot is older than this many days. Default 2.

field.label: Local backup folder
field.help: Directory containing local backup snapshot files (XML, compressed XML, backup). Default /conf/backup. Remote backup success is monitored separately from service logs.
